args.line: The note does not specify a timezone.
And where does the feed come from?
It says there is one row per 6 minutes and does not indicate that the cadence can change.
The note identifies it only as the Harbor tide feed; it gives no more specific source.

restore_subject.title: Harbor plan
restore_subject.text:
Plan for the Harbor project, owner Alex.
## Goals
Instrument the pier and publish tide data by the end of the month.
## Timeline
Kickoff on the 20th. Sensors ordered by the 18th. Dock survey on the 25th.
## Risks
Permit renewal is slow. Vendor quotes may exceed budget.
## Checklist
- [ ] vendor shortlist
- [x] tide feed access
- [ ] survey booked

comments.text: Please add a Status section at the end listing what blocks the Dock survey.

args.append: - Dock survey is blocked by Order pier sensors and Harbor permit renewal.
